nodes.name: Paying agent or application
nodes.description: An AI agent, orchestrator or application that wants an independent reliability score for an x402 endpoint before routing a payment to it. Pays per call in USDC.

nodes.name: Auditor or relying party
nodes.description: Anyone holding a Hosannaith result (an auditor, an SLA record, a registry) who verifies its signature independently, without trusting the channel it arrived through.

nodes.name: Hosannaith reliability oracle
nodes.description: Independent reliability oracle for x402 pay-per-call endpoints on Algorand. Measures uptime, correct HTTP 402 behaviour, latency and payment-requirement conformance from continuous unpaid probing, and sells signed scores per call over x402.

nodes.name: Oracle HTTP API
nodes.description: x402 resource server. GET /reliability and POST /reliability/batch are paid per call (USDC on Algorand); free routes publish the OpenAPI document, JSON Schemas, llms.txt, the signing key set and signed public reports. Refuses targets on private or reserved addresses before payment. A target with no history gets one unpaid live probe through the same guarded probe as the monitor (redirects followed by hand, every hop resolved, private or reserved addresses refused). Offers both Algorand network id forms in every 402 during the CAIP-2 transition.

tool-chain-validation.description: AIGF MI-19 Tool Chain Validation and Sanitization. Tool inputs are validated before payment (public http(s) URL, fixed windows, batch size; private and reserved addresses refused), and tool output cannot carry free text from a monitored endpoint.

config.name: Tool Chain Validation and Sanitization
config.description: Tool inputs are validated before payment (public http(s) URL, fixed windows, batch size; private and reserved addresses refused), and tool output cannot carry free text from a monitored endpoint.

decision-audit.description: AIGF MI-21 Agent Decision Audit and Explainability. Signed results and signed public reports that a firm can store with its agents' decisions and that anyone can verify against the published keys.

config.name: Agent Decision Audit and Explainability
config.description: Signed results and signed public reports that a firm can store with its agents' decisions and that anyone can verify against the published keys.

nodes.name: Remote MCP server
nodes.description: Model Context Protocol server (Streamable HTTP) exposing the same paid checks as MCP tools, paid via x402 MCP. Tools carry MCP annotations; every call is written to an audit log.

mcp-security.description: AIGF MI-20 MCP Server Security Governance. What a firm vetting Hosannaith as an outside MCP server can check: open source, dependency and license checks, signed results, published schemas, release provenance, security policy.

config.name: MCP Server Security Governance
config.description: What a firm vetting Hosannaith as an outside MCP server can check: open source, dependency and license checks, signed results, published schemas, release provenance, security policy.

tool-chain-validation.description: AIGF MI-19 Tool Chain Validation and Sanitization. Tool inputs are validated before payment (public http(s) URL, fixed windows, batch size; private and reserved addresses refused), and tool output cannot carry free text from a monitored endpoint.

config.name: Tool Chain Validation and Sanitization
config.description: Tool inputs are validated before payment (public http(s) URL, fixed windows, batch size; private and reserved addresses refused), and tool output cannot carry free text from a monitored endpoint.

nodes.name: Monitor
nodes.description: Separate long-running process that probes every enrolled endpoint about every 3 minutes WITHOUT paying, and records status, latency and what each 402 asks for (networks, x402 version, discovery metadata). Follows redirects itself and resolves every hop, refusing private or reserved addresses.

ai-observability.description: AIGF MI-04 AI System Observability. Independent measurements of the outside x402 endpoints an agent calls: availability, error rate, latency and payment gating, over rolling windows.

config.name: AI System Observability
config.description: Independent measurements of the outside x402 endpoints an agent calls: availability, error rate, latency and payment gating, over rolling windows.

nodes.name: Observation log
nodes.description: Append-only history of every probe. History compounds and cannot be backfilled; scores for 24-hour, 7-day and 30-day windows are computed from it at read time.

nodes.name: Target registry
nodes.description: The set of endpoints the monitor probes. A target first queried through the API or MCP server is enrolled here (after passing the target rules).

nodes.name: MCP audit log
nodes.description: One record per remote MCP tool call: the on-chain settlement receipt for paid calls, or the quote offered for unpaid ones. Never records payment payloads or URL query strings. Size-bounded with rotation.

nodes.name: Attestation signing key
nodes.description: ECDSA P-256 private key used to sign every result (ES256). Generated on the host, readable only by the services, never logged, never backed up, never leaves the host.

nodes.name: Published key set (JWKS)
nodes.description: Public keys for verifying Hosannaith signatures, with RFC 7638 key ids, key status and a revoked-keys list. Served free by the API (interface `jwks`).

nodes.name: Report signer
nodes.description: Operator-run tool that builds a dated public reliability report for a named set of endpoints from the observation log and signs it with the attestation key. Run only where the key is.

decision-audit.description: AIGF MI-21 Agent Decision Audit and Explainability. Signed results and signed public reports that a firm can store with its agents' decisions and that anyone can verify against the published keys.

config.name: Agent Decision Audit and Explainability
config.description: Signed results and signed public reports that a firm can store with its agents' decisions and that anyone can verify against the published keys.

nodes.name: Signed public reports
nodes.description: Dated, signed reliability reports for named endpoints, never edited after publishing. Served free by the API and linked from hosannaith.com.

nodes.name: hosannaith-client (npm)
nodes.description: TypeScript client: performs the x402 payment handshake and verifies every result's signature against the published key set by default. Includes a reliability guard that vets an endpoint before an agent pays it.

credential-protection.description: AIGF MI-23 Agentic System Credential Protection Framework. Hosannaith issues no credentials. The only secret involved is the caller's own payment key, which stays with the caller. The local MCP package reads that key from an environment variable.

nodes.name: x402 facilitator (GoPlausible)
nodes.description: Third-party x402 facilitator that verifies and settles USDC payments on Algorand for the oracle. Hosannaith never holds customer funds; the payTo account is receive-only.

nodes.name: Algorand mainnet
nodes.description: Settlement layer. Payments are USDC (ASA 31566704) transfers to a fixed, receive-only payTo account.

nodes.name: Monitored x402 endpoints
nodes.description: Third-party x402 endpoints that Hosannaith scores. Probed without payment; never sent a request body.

flows.name: Paid reliability check
flows.description: An agent buys a signed reliability score for an endpoint before paying that endpoint, and verifies the signature.

transitions.description: Agent asks the client for a score for a target endpoint
Unpaid request is answered with HTTP 402 and payment requirements; the client retries with a signed USDC payment
API has the facilitator verify the payment
API scores the target from its accumulated history
Facilitator settles the USDC transfer on Algorand
Client verifies the signature against the published key set before returning the result

flows.name: Paid reliability check over MCP
flows.description: An agent calls the hosted MCP server's paid tool; the call is verified, scored, signed, settled and recorded in the audit log.

transitions.description: Agent calls the paid tool with an x402 payment in the request metadata
MCP server has the facilitator verify the payment
MCP server scores the target from its accumulated history
Facilitator settles the USDC transfer on Algorand
The call is recorded in the audit log with its settlement receipt

flows.name: Continuous monitoring
flows.description: The monitor builds the independent history that every score is computed from.

transitions.description: Monitor probes each target without paying

flows.name: Independent verification
flows.description: A relying party checks a result it received second-hand, trusting only the published key set.

transitions.description: Relying party fetches the key set from the API and verifies the result's signature and key status
